title: Allow to set custom icon for bluetooth devices
line: You can now pick your own icon for each Bluetooth device from its page in System Settings, and the Bluetooth widget uses it.
explanation: BlueZ guesses a device's icon from its device class and the icon is read-only, so a speaker that reports itself as a headset always showed headphones; bluedevil let you rename a device but not change its icon. The device page in the Bluetooth settings now has an Icon row with Choose… (the standard icon dialog) and Reset to Default Icon. The choice is stored per device address in bluedevilglobalrc ([DeviceIcons]), and the shared devices model used by both the widget and the settings list returns it instead of the guessed icon, updating live through KConfigWatcher.

commits.message:
kcm: allow choosing a custom icon for each device

Devices could be renamed but their icon was always the one guessed from
the device class, which is often wrong. The device page now has an icon
chooser, and the applet and device list show the chosen icon instead.

BUG: 433338
